roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.summary: Builds the interfaces people click, type and scroll in the browser.

roles.title: Backend Developer
roles.summary: Builds the APIs, databases and services behind every app.

roles.title: Full Stack Developer
roles.summary: Ships whole features, from database to button.

roles.title: Mobile Developer
roles.summary: Builds iOS and Android apps, native or cross-platform.

roles.title: Game Developer
roles.summary: Builds games with engines like Unity, Unreal and Godot.

roles.title: Embedded & IoT Engineer
roles.summary: Writes software for microcontrollers and connected devices.

roles.title: QA / SDET
roles.summary: Designs test strategy and automation so teams ship with confidence.

roles.title: Software Architect
roles.summary: Shapes how large systems are split, connected and evolved.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.summary: Turns raw data into answers, dashboards and decisions.

roles.title: BI Analyst
roles.summary: Builds the metrics layer and reporting a business runs on.

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.summary: Builds pipelines and warehouses that move and model data reliably.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.summary: Uses statistics and ML to explain, predict and experiment.

roles.title: Database Engineer
roles.summary: Designs, tunes and protects the databases everything depends on.

roles.title: ML Engineer
roles.summary: Trains, evaluates and ships machine learning models to production.

roles.title: MLOps Engineer
roles.summary: Builds the platforms that train, deploy and monitor models.

roles.title: Gen AI Engineer
roles.summary: Builds products on LLMs: prompting, RAG, fine-tuning and evals.

roles.title: AI Agent Engineer
roles.summary: Builds agents that plan, call tools and act, safely and observably.

roles.title: AI Research Scientist
roles.summary: Invents and tests new model architectures and training methods.

roles.title: Computer Vision Engineer
roles.summary: Teaches machines to understand images and video.

roles.title: NLP Engineer
roles.summary: Builds systems that read, classify and generate language.

roles.title: AI Red Teaming & Safety
roles.summary: Finds how AI systems fail or can be misused, and helps fix it.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.summary: Automates build, test, release and infrastructure.

roles.title: Site Reliability Engineer
roles.summary: Keeps production fast and available using software and SLOs.

roles.title: Cloud Engineer
roles.summary: Designs and runs systems on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.

roles.title: Platform Engineer
roles.summary: Builds the internal platform other engineers ship on.

roles.title: Network Engineer
roles.summary: Designs and secures the networks that connect everything.

roles.title: Cybersecurity (SOC) Analyst
roles.summary: Detects, investigates and responds to security incidents.

roles.title: Penetration Tester
roles.summary: Breaks into systems, with permission, to find weaknesses first.

roles.title: DevSecOps / Cloud Security
roles.summary: Builds security into pipelines, cloud and code.

roles.title: UX / UI Designer
roles.summary: Researches users and designs products that are clear and usable.

roles.title: Product Manager
roles.summary: Decides what to build and why, and gets it shipped.

roles.title: Engineering Manager
roles.summary: Grows engineers and teams that deliver.

roles.title: Technical Writer
roles.summary: Writes the docs and guides developers learn from.

roles.title: Developer Relations
roles.summary: Helps developers succeed with a product through content and community.

roles.title: Blockchain / Web3 Developer
roles.summary: Builds smart contracts and decentralised apps.

roles.title: AR / VR (XR) Developer
roles.summary: Builds immersive experiences for headsets and phones.

roles.title: Quantum Computing Engineer
roles.summary: Writes and tests algorithms for quantum hardware.

roles.title: Robotics Engineer
roles.summary: Builds robots that sense, plan and move.

roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
roles.summary: Embeds with customers to build and deploy AI solutions on site.
